correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<kappa<1 and gamma>0, q_n=2^n b_n/n with 1<=b_n<2^gamma gives q_n^(1/n)->2 and rho_n->0. Ordinary and dyadic-reset quotients have only the limits 2 and 2^(1-gamma). The convolution ratio sum_{j<n}q_j/q_n is uniformly bounded by splitting the weighted geometric tail at j=n/2, giving the product hypothesis of Boc Thaler Theorem 1.7 and hence parabolicity for every gamma. For 0<gamma<1, d_n=2q_n-q_(n+1)>0 eventually and grows on ordinary steps like c_gamma*2^n/n^2 and on resets like a positive fraction of q_n; therefore Theorem 1.6(ii) gives C^2 and E_n=sum_{j<=n}q_j-q_(n+1) grows exponentially, implying sum kappa^(E_n)<infinity. For gamma=1, q_n=2^(n-floor(log_2 n)), E_n=C_k on exactly 2^k indices 2^k-1..2^(k+1)-2, C_1=0 and C_(k+1)-C_k=2^(2^(k+1)-k-1); hence sum 2^k*kappa^(C_k)<infinity. The remaining tail after a gamma=1 block is negligible compared with its first block mass, so 1<=L_n/lambda_n<=2^(k+1), alpha_n=log(1/L_n)/log(1/lambda_n)->1; Boc Thaler Theorem 1.9 yields basin C^2 also at this endpoint. For gamma>1, at N_k=2^(k+1)-2, the within-block geometric-moment expansion and exponentially negligible earlier blocks give E_(N_k)/q_(N_k+1)=-2(gamma-1)/(N_k+1)+O(N_k^(-2)); since q_(N_k+1)/N_k->infinity, E_(N_k)->-infinity and lambda_(N_k)->infinity, so normalization summability fails. This proves the if-and-only-if threshold; the proof does not establish biholomorphy for gamma>1. Independent exact integer checks of eight endpoint blocks and high-precision tests across 35 gamma/reset configurations corroborate, but do not replace, the unrestricted arguments.

value.rationale: Boc Thaler explicitly identifies two natural axes of an open regime—critical root growth without a convergent successive quotient, and convergence of derivative normalization. The explicit dyadic family isolates both, realizes every lower quotient floor L in (0,2), proves a sharp L=1 summability boundary and shows why the endpoint requires a stronger capture argument. This is a motivated infinite-parameter phase boundary rather than a gratuitous number or ordinary substitution. It does not purport to resolve the nonsummable basins' biholomorphism class.
